scripts.build: bun run build:api && bun run build:cost-guard && bun run build:security-guard
scripts.build:api: bun build src/lambda.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/api/index.mjs && cd dist/api && python3 -m zipfile -c ../api.zip index.mjs
scripts.build:cost-guard: bun build src/cost-guard.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/cost-guard/index.mjs && cd dist/cost-guard && python3 -m zipfile -c ../cost-guard.zip index.mjs
scripts.build:security-guard: bun build src/security-guard.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/security-guard/index.mjs && cd dist/security-guard && python3 -m zipfile -c ../security-guard.zip index.mjs
